_about.note: Evidence category of every WeatherConfig field (scripts/core/weather_config.gd) used by the Prompt 09 weather part. Categories: balance (game tuning, never a NASA figure), game transformation (how archive episodes become game events: accelerated gaps, severity scaling, duration stretch; NOT NASA-observed storm frequency), engineering (software behaviour), contract (fixed by the project brief), physics, S01/S02 (register sources). The opacity curves, wind, sols and Ls themselves come from the data bundle (data/weather/bundle, part D) and its own source register entries.

refresh_hours.note: Check for published updates at startup and every hour while online.

retry_first_minutes.note: First retry after a failed check: 1 real minute, doubling after each failure.

retry_cap_minutes.note: Retry wait capped at 60 real minutes.

default_timeout_s.note: Timeout of one download when the refresh entry gives none (20 s).

default_max_bytes.note: Largest download accepted when the refresh entry gives no limit (2 MB).

start_ls.note: Solar longitude of sol 0 of a new game; -1 = the earliest ls_start of the bundle, so the colony starts in the observed season.

mars_year_sols.note: One Mars year is about 668.6 sols (orbital period 686.98 Earth days, S01, divided by the sol length, S02). The game's Ls advances with the sol count.

orbit_eccentricity.note: 0.0935, Mars Fact Sheet orbital eccentricity; used in the equation of the centre for Ls.

ls_perihelion_deg.note: Ls of perihelion, about 251 degrees: standard orbital element of Mars. Ls = true anomaly + 251 degrees.

scale_sky_to_default.note: The archive opacity is multiplied by one factor so the sky at the start of a new game equals GameBalance.dust_tau_default (0.5); the seasonal shape and the episode curves keep their archive proportions. The factor is saved per game (state.weather.sky_scale).

max_tau.note: Upper bound of the opacity the game uses (4).

teach_min_sols.note: No dust event before 2 sols and before the panel response was taught (a panel cleaned, or evidence energy_diagnose_output_loss), whichever is later.

first_gap_hours_min.note: The first event starts 6 to 14 game hours after the teaching condition.

minor_severity_max.note: The first event uses the archive's smallest episode at 22 to 35 % of its observed opacity rise: minor.

gap_sols_min.note: Calm sols between events, 1 to 4, drawn per seed. ACCELERATED: not NASA-observed storm frequency.

gap_shape.note: Shape of the gap draw (1.4: short gaps somewhat more common).

stretch_min.note: An episode's observed duration is stretched by 0.75 to 1.35, per event.

severity_step.note: Severity = share of the episode's observed opacity rise above its own background. Escalation: the ceiling grows by 0.25 per event, from the minor first one, up to severity_max.

severity_max.note: Highest severity scale, 1.25 (25 % above the observed rise).

severity_low_share.note: A later event uses 45 to 100 % of its escalation ceiling.

readiness_cap_low.note: Severity cap at the warning when the colony is least ready (0.4) ...

readiness_cap_high.note: ... and when it is fully ready (1.25). Readiness = weighted battery above the reserve, cleaner working, clean panels, life support fine.

battery_reserve_kwh.note: Life-support battery reserve, 120 kWh: about one night of control, heating, scrubber, fans and recycler.

recovery_hours_min.note: At least 18 game hours between the end of an event and the next start; up to twice as long when the colony is not ready.

hold_battery_factor.note: An event is held back while the battery is below 1.5 x the reserve or an urgent alert is active ...

hold_dust.note: After the first, minor event, the next one also waits while the panels are at least 20 % dusty on average and the cleaner does not work: dust management before escalation (a storm's dust on uncleaned panels would otherwise leave a lasting power deficit).

readiness_weights.note: Weights of battery, cleaner, panels and life support in readiness: 0.35, 0.25, 0.25, 0.15.

return_margin.note: The warning comes at least 2 x the longest current outdoor walk home (ReturnRoutes at suit walking speed) before the opacity starts to rise.

min_warning_hours.note: And never less than 4 game hours.

route_max_slope_deg.note: 40 degrees, the player's steepest walkable slope (PlayerTuning.max_slope_degrees).

route_slope_penalty.note: Walking cost = distance x (1 + slope grade).

route_body_radius_m.note: Obstacles grown by the player's capsule radius, 0.22 m (PlayerTuning.body_radius_m).

route_step_m.note: Obstacles lower than 0.25 m are stepped over (PlayerTuning.step_height_m).

sun_min_share.note: Presentation: sun light never below 25 % of normal.

sky_min_share.note: Presentation: sky brightness never below 35 % of normal.

fog_density_per_tau.note: Presentation: fog density added per unit of opacity above the default.

fog_density_max.note: Presentation: upper bound of the added fog density.

sky_follow_rate.note: Presentation: how fast the shown sky follows the opacity (1/s).

dust_particles_max.note: Presentation: at most 160 dust particles around an outdoor player.

dust_particles_from_tau.note: Presentation: particles start 0.25 above the default opacity.
